Main text in one column: a paragraph continuing from the previous page, then a decorative border, then a display title (three lines, italic), a chapter heading "CAP. No marginal notes in either margin, only show-through, which is left out.

main_text.p: Diuin. decret. 10 Sacramenta denique nihil nos Christianos iuuare. Itaque impunè & sine piaculo contemni. Quod & de Baptismo, & de sacra Domini Cœna ab iis dici manifestè scribit Theodoret.libr.4.hist. cap.ii.Si quis autem alia eorundem dogma nosse volet, legat Ioannis Damasceni opusculum De hæresibus. Atq; hæc fuit mali furculi monachismi scilicet mala stirps quæ serpentis diaboli veneno infecta, etiam nunc pestifer os profert fructus.

head.i: HAERESES EX Philastro ab Augustino collecta & transcripta.

main_text.head: CAP. LVIII.
Metangismonitæ cur sic appellati. Erroris au-tem caput duplex.

p.i: Metangismonitæ{1} dici possunt, qui Metangismon afferunt, dicentes sic esse in Patre{2} Filium, quomodo vas in vase, quasi duo corpora carnaliter opinantes, ita ut Filius intret in Patrem tanquam vas minus in vas maius. Unde & tale nomen hic error accepit, ut Μεταγγισμὸς Græce diceretur. Ἀγγεῖον quippe illa lingua vas dicitur, sed introitus unius vasis in alterum, Latinè uno nomine non potest dici, sicut Græce potuit Μεταγγισμός.

page.notes: Woodcut ornamental border above the title and woodcut initial M are not text. Footnote marks {1} and {2} are printed in the text, but their notes are not on this page, so none is transcribed. "Diuin. decret." at the start of the continuing paragraph is set in the text column, so it is kept as text. The numeral "10" is kept as a section number. "cap.ii." is uncertain: the printed numeral may be read as "11" or "ii" [?]. The mark after "Ioannis" is a printed dash or flourish, not transcribed. The bottom right "I" is read as a signature and "Me-" as a catchword, but the "1" in the lower left of the text may be a footnote mark. Greek accents on Μεταγγισμὸς and Μεταγγισμός are uncertain. Show-through from the reverse side is left out.
